title: 1989: A Constitutional Revolution Without Violence
grammar: Modals of entitlement and duty: jogosult and köteles ('entitled to / obliged to + inf')
goal: I can analyze the legal mechanics of Hungary's 1989 peaceful transition to democracy.
I can use jogosult and köteles with infinitive complements to specify rights and duties in public law.
I can describe the National Roundtable discussions, the declaration of the Republic, and rule-of-law guarantees.
